name: Greater City Aquarium Society (GCAS)
neighborhoods: Queens / NYC; meets at the Alley Pond Environmental Center, Douglaston
region_note: FISH & AQUATIC (aquarium fish, goldfish, bettas; aquatic turtles are under reptiles)
notes: NYC aquarium society founded 1922. Monthly meetings March to November, 7:30pm, at the Alley Pond Environmental Center, 229-10 Northern Boulevard, Douglaston (Queens), with an auction of fish, plants and equipment for members. To rehome fish or plants, use the web form on its contact page, or come to a meeting and join. A Queens-side option for rehoming aquarium fish and getting care advice. Never release aquarium fish into local waters.
type_raw: Aquarium hobbyist society - rehoming via monthly auctions
section: FISH & AQUATIC (aquarium fish, goldfish, bettas; aquatic turtles are under reptiles)
